info.name: Amazon CloudFront Distributions API
info.description:
Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) service that accelerates delivery of your websites, APIs, video content, and other web assets. The CloudFront API enables you to programmatically manage distributions, invalidations, functions, and other CloudFront resources.

Contact Support:
 Name: Amazon Web Services
